    ys=[p[0] for p in cells]; xs=[p[1] for p in cells]
    return frozenset(tuple(sorted((y-min(ys),x-min(xs)) for y,x in cells)))

    # count occurrences of each shape across the whole grid

def load():

G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def comps(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=max([v for row in g for v in row],key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]!=bg and (r,c) not in seen:
                col=g[r][c]; st=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=set()
                while st:

                ys=[p[0] for p in cells]; xs=[p[1] for p in cells]

def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cs,bg=comps_of(g)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    bynorm=defaultdict(list)
    for q in cs: bynorm[norm(q['cells'])].append(q)
    changed=set()
    for k,l in bynorm.items():
        l.sort(key=lambda x:x['n'])
        if len(l)>1 and all(qs[0]['n']<qs[1]['n'] for qs in [l][:2]):
            small=l[0]
            for y,x in small['cells']: out[y][x]=l[1]['col']
            changed.add(small['r0'],small['c0'])
    return out,changed
for i in range(1,9):
    gi=G['Demo pair %d input'%i]; go=G['Demo pair %d output'%i]
    res,ch=solve(gi)
